html:
Exciting events during National Day 2/9, please refer to Vietlook Travel to choose for yourself a satisfactory vacation and experience the culture of each region during this holiday.

This year’s National Day lasts 4 days, so many places are holding exciting events, aiming to bring visitors the most enjoyable holiday, with exciting entertainment games. Especially in big cities like Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Ha Long…

In Hanoi

Welcoming the 79th anniversary of the August Revolution and National Day 2/9, all the streets of the capital Hanoi are decorated with flags, flowers, banners, slogans, propaganda paintings, large billboards… brilliant and exciting on the holiday.

If you travel to Hanoi on the occasion of National Day September 2, visitors should experience the double-decker bus, “Hanoi City Tour” to visit and explore Hanoi’s famous landmarks for 4 days from September 1 to 4, and visitors will also receive gifts on the day of visiting Uncle Ho’s mausoleum on September 2. Free ticket distribution time is from 12:00 to 17:00 from August 31 to September 3, 2024 at the 19/8 Flower Garden area opposite the Hanoi Opera House. Departure, pick-up and drop-off location: Parking lot next to the Opera House.

Along with that, there are art performances in Hoan Kiem District, Ha Dong District Cultural House, Nam Tu Liem District, Quoc Oai District, Dan Phuong, Me Linh, Dong Anh, Phuc Tho, Thanh Oai …

In Ho Chi Minh City

On the occasion of National Day, there is a ceremony to offer incense and flowers to President Ho Chi Minh and President Ton Duc Thang at the Ho Chi Minh Museum, City Branch. Ho Chi Minh City, Ton Duc Thang Museum, President Ho Chi Minh Monument Park.

In addition, when traveling to Ho Chi Minh City on September 2, visitors can also immerse themselves in the vibrant fireworks display at the Saigon River Tunnel and at Dam Sen Cultural Park, the fireworks display lasts about 15 minutes, from 9:00 p.m. to 9:15 p.m. on September 2.

In Da Nang

The venue for many exciting events during the National Day holiday on September 2, the boat racing festival takes place on the Han River, this is one of the vibrant cultural and sporting activities of Da Nang.

In addition, if you travel to Da Nang on the occasion of National Day September 2, visitors can also join street festivals, such as singing Bai Choi, performing Tuong, street music, visitors will be dressed up as funny characters in gorgeous costumes that will bring visitors unforgettable experiences, besides, visitors can also watch free movie screenings at famous landmarks or walking streets…

At Asia Park (Danang Downtown), there is a program to thank local people with the shows “Awaken River – The River Wakes Up” and Vietnamese Puppetry. Besides, visitors can also participate in the fireworks show that takes place every night during the holiday.

In Ha Long (Quang Ninh)

Hot air balloon festival, this is the first festival in Ha Long, traveling to Ha Long on the occasion of National Day September 2nd, visitors will be able to participate in flying with professional guides, and experience releasing festival lanterns to promote the image of tourism and people of Ha Long to international visitors and friends. This is one of the programs to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Ha Long Bay becoming a World Natural Heritage (1994 – 2024).

In addition, at Tuan Chau beach, Ha Long, there is also a parasailing festival, jet ski… with the participation of professional athletes, bringing visitors exciting feelings on the occasion of National Day September 2nd in Ha Long.

In Quang Binh September 2nd

Traditional boat racing festival, cultural and artistic activities, sports activities, fairs. In addition, music events and vibrant fireworks displays will also take place at scenic spots in Quang Binh.

In Mu Cang Chai (Yen Bai) September 2

On Independence Day September 2, in Mu Cang Chai, a golden paragliding festival will take place, flying in the air, admiring the golden terraced fields, with the participation of 6 street parade groups performing folk dances imbued with the culture of the Mong and Thai ethnic groups in Mu Cang Chai, along with parade cars carrying local fruits, Son Tra (apple) trees and other local specialties.

Along with the “Flying over the scenic spots” paragliding festival, visitors will also participate in the “Banh Day pounding festival”, and visitors will also visit the Vietnam Heritage Tree.

In Than Uyen (Lai Chau) 2/9

Celebrating Independence Day, there are also many exciting events such as: Youth Music, Walking Street Stage, 15/10 Street, and KOMOMO International Running Race and sports such as: Crossbow shooting, stick pushing, tu lu fighting, to ma le, tug of war… and Thai ethnic cultural exchange.

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to experience Vietnam tours to explore famous places, or immerse yourself in events and festivals, each location will have its own culture, especially the special events taking place during the holiday.
